python3 - <<'PY'
import serial, time, re
port='/dev/cu.usbserial-1130'
s=serial.Serial()
s.port=port; s.baudrate=115200; s.timeout=0.25; s.dtr=False; s.rts=False; s.open()
print('SERIAL_OPEN_OK', s.name, s.baudrate)
start=time.time(); lines=[]
while time.time()-start < 35:
    raw=s.readline()
    if not raw: continue
    txt=raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace').rstrip()
    lines.append((time.time()-start, txt))
s.close()
print('TOTAL_LINES', len(lines))
keys=('scd','co2','rtc','time','temp','humid','rh','sensor','climate','eink','display')
relevant=[x for x in lines if any(k in x[1].lower() for k in keys)]
print('RELEVANT_LINES', len(relevant))
for t,txt in relevant[-160:]: print(f'{t:06.2f}s | {txt}')
if not relevant:
    print('NO_KEYWORD_MATCHES_LAST_RAW_LINES')
    for t,txt in lines[-100:]: print(f'{t:06.2f}s | {txt}')
PY
